up: List all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3886195. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (pref_name), and its canonical SMILES. sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3886195';
